name: 167860ac-diary-default-today
description: Ошибка 167860ac: вход в «Дневник» без отбора позиционирован на текущей дате. Чистый профиль: период $today/$today (2 ячейки), выделено сегодня (1), лента — записи за сегодня (1/1), снимок вкладки не записан. Вторая вкладка той же сети получает СВОЙ дефолт (а не отбор соседней). Сеть без записей: тот же дефолт и пустая лента. Возврат в первую вкладку — восстановлен её собственный снимок. Красная фаза на коде до фикса (диагностика): 0/0/3 и снимок null.

steps.name: open-network
steps.probe: (() => { const items = [...document.querySelectorAll('.network-item')]; const item = items.find((e) => (e.textContent || '').includes('{{networkName}}')) ?? items[0]; if (item === undefined) return 'no-item'; item.click(); return 'ok'; })()

steps.name: seed-records
steps.probe: (async () => { const pad = (n) => String(n).padStart(2, '0'); const local = (d) => `${d.getFullYear()}-${pad(d.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad(d.getDate())}`; const now = new Date(); const at = (o) => new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate() + o, 12, 0, 0, 0); const days = [-5, -2, 0].map((o) => local(at(o))); for (const day of days) { const iso = new Date(day + 'T12:00:00').toISOString(); await window.etn.comments.create('{{networkId}}', 'thought', '{{thoughtId}}', { kind: 'chronological', title: 'Проба ' + day, body_md: 'запись ' + day, valid_from: iso, valid_to: iso }); } window.__probe167860 = { today: local(now), days }; return 'ok'; })()

steps.name: default-entry-numbers
steps.probe: (async () => { const tabs = await window.etn.tabs.list(); const active = document.querySelector('button.tab.tab-active')?.dataset.tabId; const row = tabs.find((t) => t.tab_id === active); return { today: window.__probe167860.today, seededDays: window.__probe167860.days, periodCells: document.querySelectorAll('.chron-filter .fv-date').length, from: document.querySelector('.chron-filter .fv-date[data-bound="from"] select')?.value ?? null, to: document.querySelector('.chron-filter .fv-date[data-bound="to"] select')?.value ?? null, selectedCells: document.querySelectorAll('.cal-day.is-selected').length, todayCells: document.querySelectorAll('.cal-day.is-today').length, feedDays: document.querySelectorAll('.diary-day').length, feedRecords: document.querySelectorAll('.diary-record').length, chronicle_state: row?.chronicle_state ?? null }; })()

steps.name: default-entry-gate
steps.probe: (async () => { const tabs = await window.etn.tabs.list(); const active = document.querySelector('button.tab.tab-active')?.dataset.tabId; const row = tabs.find((t) => t.tab_id === active); const from = document.querySelector('.chron-filter .fv-date[data-bound="from"] select')?.value ?? null; const to = document.querySelector('.chron-filter .fv-date[data-bound="to"] select')?.value ?? null; const problems = []; if (document.querySelectorAll('.chron-filter .fv-date').length !== 2) problems.push('periodCells'); if (from !== '$today' || to !== '$today') problems.push('period=' + from + '..' + to); if (document.querySelectorAll('.cal-day.is-selected').length !== 1) problems.push('selected'); if (document.querySelectorAll('.cal-day.is-today.is-selected').length !== 1) problems.push('selected-not-today'); if (document.querySelectorAll('.diary-day').length !== 1 || document.querySelectorAll('.diary-record').length !== 1) problems.push('feed'); if (row?.chronicle_state != null) problems.push('persisted'); return problems.length === 0 ? 'ok' : problems.join('; '); })()

steps.name: first-tab-snapshot
steps.probe: (async () => { const tabs = await window.etn.tabs.list(); const active = document.querySelector('button.tab.tab-active')?.dataset.tabId; const row = tabs.find((t) => t.tab_id === active); return typeof row?.chronicle_state === 'string' && row.chronicle_state.includes('record_time') ? 'ok' : 'no-snapshot'; })()
